evals.name: batch-my-recipes
evals.prompt: Validate all the food recipes in D:/AI_Agents/Projects/Mikes_AI_Lab/Repos/Live_Apps/AI-Automation-Library/My-Library/Cooking/Recipes/My-Recipes and give me a report on any quality, health, or safety issues.
evals.expected_output: A markdown validation report: recipes grouped by verdict (needs fixes / pass with notes / pass), each with severity-ranked findings (food-safety, nutrition, quality/coherence, allergen) and concrete fixes. Should catch the high-sodium/sat-fat/cholesterol dishes, undeclared allergens (these clippings recipes have no allergens field), and any missing cook temps — without false-flagging indulgent dishes as 'bad'.

evals.name: single-texas-chili
evals.prompt: Is this recipe any good? Check it for quality and safety problems: D:/AI_Agents/Projects/Mikes_AI_Lab/Repos/Live_Apps/AI-Automation-Library/My-Library/Cooking/Recipes/My-Recipes/Recipes/Texas Chili.md
evals.expected_output: An inline review of the one recipe: flags the very-high saturated fat (~17g), high cholesterol/sodium/calories per serving with honest framing (rich chili, expected but heavy), checks for a safe cook endpoint on the beef, checks allergen completeness and coherence, and gives a verdict + concrete fixes. Should NOT declare a hearty chili 'bad' purely for being rich.

evals.name: single-burger-safety
evals.prompt: Review D:/AI_Agents/Projects/Mikes_AI_Lab/Repos/Live_Apps/AI-Automation-Library/My-Library/Cooking/Recipes/Regions/Recipes/American/ClassicBurger.md — is it safe to cook and well made?
evals.expected_output: An inline review focused on food safety: a ground-beef burger must reach 160°F internal — flag if the recipe gives no internal temperature or only a color/time cue. Also checks quantities vs a normal burger, coherence, and estimates nutrition (no declared table). This recipe's metadata is bold `**Key:** value` lines (not YAML), declaring gluten+dairy — the review should read those, note the egg from mayo is undeclared, and NOT invent a missing-allergens-field problem. Verdict + fixes.

evals.name: single-canning-highacid
evals.prompt: Check this preserving recipe for safety: D:/AI_Agents/Projects/Mikes_AI_Lab/Repos/Live_Apps/AI-Automation-Library/My-Library/Cooking/Recipes/Regions/Recipes/midwest/midwest_apple-butter_v1.md
evals.expected_output: Recognizes apple butter is a HIGH-acid food (fruit) that is correctly and safely processed in a boiling-water bath — so the scanner's home-canning flag is NOT a critical food-safety failure here. Should NOT declare it unsafe for using a water bath. May still note tested-recipe/altitude/headspace caveats. Contrast with a low-acid canning recipe (plain vegetables/meat) which WOULD need a pressure canner. Verdict should be pass / pass-with-notes, not needs-fixes.

evals.name: single-tableformat-allergens
evals.expected_output: This recipe declares its metadata (including allergens: gluten) in a markdown TABLE, not YAML frontmatter — the review must read the table, not treat the recipe as having no allergen labeling. Genuine allergen gap: the marinade uses soy sauce OR Worcestershire, so soy (soy sauce) and/or fish (anchovy in Worcestershire) are present but undeclared — flag them. Should not re-flag the already-declared gluten. Plus honest nutrition framing (elevated sodium from soy/salt) and a verdict.

evals.name: batch-full-corpus-noise
evals.prompt: Validate all the recipes under D:/AI_Agents/Projects/Mikes_AI_Lab/Repos/Live_Apps/AI-Automation-Library/My-Library/Cooking/Recipes and give me a prioritized report.
evals.expected_output: A batch report over all three families that leads with the genuine food-safety issues (e.g. ground-beef dishes with no safe endpoint, raw-fish handling) and real allergen-labeling gaps, frames nutrition honestly by dish type, and does NOT drown in false positives: recipes with no allergens field should collapse to informational notes (not per-allergen warnings), high-acid canning (pickles/fruit butters/acidified relish) should not be called unsafe, and keyword false friends (butter beans, oyster mushroom, coconut milk, plant-based butter, ingredient-swap lines) should not be reported as allergens. Should scale without reading every clean recipe end to end.
